Replacing `P[label]` with `T[image]` for both views makes canonical anchoring zero mathematically at initialization; augmented anchoring is generally `||U−T||²`, not zero. Using U for augmented targets would define a different intervention. Native arithmetic may also leave small canonical residuals across batch sizes/devices. Do not demand bitwise zero or introduce a replacement normalization constant. [Teacher construction](/home/rb/worktrees/sfora-positive-causality/scripts/train_siglip2_compact_ranking.py:344)

2. **[P1] The existing arm logic and qualification assertions would invalidate this experiment.** Currently only `candidate` backpropagates ranking, and qualification requires candidate-minus-control gradient to equal the ranking contribution. The proposed comparison requires **both arms to backpropagate SmoothAP**; their gradient difference must instead equal the regression-target contribution. Retaining the old logic silently compares against regression-only training. Strictly positive regression assertions also need target-aware treatment. [Update](/home/rb/worktrees/sfora-positive-causality/scripts/train_siglip2_compact_ranking.py:1169), [gradient assertion](/home/rb/worktrees/sfora-positive-causality/scripts/train_siglip2_compact_ranking.py:740), [terminal assertion](/home/rb/worktrees/sfora-positive-causality/scripts/train_siglip2_compact_ranking.py:1485)

Do not weaken these checks globally. [Endpoint admission](/home/rb/worktrees/sfora-positive-causality/scripts/evaluate_siglip2_compact_ranking.py:977)

Moreover, recorded initial regression/ranking gradient cosine is positive, approximately `0.333/0.312`, so initial gradient opposition is not demonstrated. Prototype attraction, augmentation effects, optimizer dynamics, and fixed-teacher versus updated-gallery mismatch remain distinguishable explanations. This trial tests the target choice; it establishes neither an encoder ceiling nor a general collapse mechanism. \[
L_{\rm active}=
\frac{\sum_{v,i}\|r_i^v(A)-P_{y_i}\|^2}{128e_0}
+L_{\rm SmoothAP},
\]

\frac{\sum_{v,i}\|r_i^v(A)-T_i\|^2}{128e_0}
